svg.title: How Clearbox sorts one email
svg.desc: A tick reads one page of up to 25 messages. For each email Clearbox extracts signals from headers and history, applies guardrails that cap the allowed action, builds a compact JSON state, and asks Microsoft-Decision-1 five questions. The validated probabilities are fused with the sender prior, the model's flags and the guardrail ceiling; trash is suggested only above a calibrated threshold with a clear margin. Suggestions wait for the owner, and every decision feeds the priors and the nightly threshold calibration.

svg.text: and up to 5 similar past decisions. Trimmed in a fixed order until it fits.

svg.text: action: choice of delete, archive, keep, unsure (option order shuffled per message)

svg.text: importance: score Noise to Critical; is_record, is_expired, is_from_human: noul

svg.text: Returns probabilities and token usage. No text.

svg.text: zod schema for every answer; the confidence field is ignored; probabilities renormalized.

svg.text: Timeouts and 429 or 5xx retry after 5 and 30 minutes, then fall back to unsure.

svg.text: 7 Fuse

text.font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Blend P(delete) with the sender's Beta prior, shift mass for record, human and expired flags,

text.font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: fold every action above the ceiling into it. Trash only if P(delete) is at least tau_delete

text.font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: (0.80 to 0.99) and leads by 0.20; otherwise the best other action, or unsure below 0.55.

text.font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 8 Suggestion

text.font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: trash, archive, keep or unsure, a confidence, and up to 3 reasons from real signals,

text.font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Trash or Archive; Undo for 24 hours.
